headline: Mexico Factory Confidence Rises to 48.4 in October
summary: Mexico's factory confidence index rose to 48.4 in October from 48.0 in September, while overall business confidence dropped slightly to 48.2.
why: Manufacturing confidence surveys track underlying production conditions in Mexico, an essential export hub for North American industrial supply chains.

impacts.name: Mexico Economy
impacts.why: Factory confidence improved to 48.4 in October from 48.0 in the prior month.
